narrative: Material PL1__M4021F19 exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.87) with a statistically significant declining trend, combined with volatile lead times (CV=0.53, mean 2.14 days). The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock, creating material stockout exposure at the 95% service level. A hybrid (r,Q) policy is recommended: safety stock of 24,842 units (z=1.645 × σ_LTD=15,102) protects against combined demand and lead time uncertainty, while an EOQ-driven order quantity of 272,398 units reduces annual ordering cost from $1,654 to $609, yielding a net annual saving of $548 (29.2%). The policy is feasible within the 521,912-unit storage capacity constraint.
warnings: Significant demand trend detected - consider dynamic forecasting

research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic demand (CV=0.87) with volatile lead times requires robust z-score safety stock buffering combined with EOQ replenishment to balance holding and ordering costs efficiently. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is appropriate given the non-intermittent, high-variability demand pattern.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Medium — the capacity constraint (521,912 units) is not binding at the recommended policy (SS+OQ=297,240), but if demand trend reverses upward, safety stock recalculation may approach capacity. Recommend annual policy review.
